verdict.rationale: Honcho stores messages and has its 'deriver' process them in the background, so asynchronous memory processing is its own documented capability (gh-1, docs-10). Nothing in the evidence shows batch ingestion, ingestion at scale, or any way to check the status or progress of background operations. 'honcho doctor' only verifies connection and workspace health, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk message ingestion endpoint, evidence of ingestion at scale, API or CLI to check status of background deriver/memory operations, and independent corroboration.
